narrative: The book open on Garnish's stool. At the head of a blank margin, one letter. No digits anywhere beneath it. No face. The same margin. The pen hovers and does not come down. The K stands alone. The book shut, a thumb on the cover. The stable door is open in the background. No figure has been written on the cover.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked, and did not call for a figure.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: Had written the K, and did not write under it.
